rationale: Luke and Evan are both building AI developer tools in San Francisco and share deep conviction around making development more accessible—Luke through adaptive learning and AI-powered course generation, Evan through universal code sharing and agentic interfaces via Expo Agent. They have complementary skill stacks (Luke's Python/ML infrastructure background pairs well with Evan's React Native/TypeScript expertise) and both are betting on AI-driven tooling as a meaningful productivity shift, making them natural collaborators on the intersection of AI, developer experience, and creative technology.
intro_message: Luke Bechtel, meet Evan Bacon — you're both building AI tools to make development more accessible, and your backgrounds (adaptive learning + universal app deployment) complement each other on the full stack from model to user interface.
